# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering performance and reliability**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves rendering reliability while reducing allocations in image and text-processing paths. It synchronizes Android texture rendering with display refresh, bundles required WebGPU native support, and fixes retained front-buffered stream data.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Android texture rendering follows display refresh** — Texture-backed Android rendering is synchronized with display refresh to provide smoother presentation. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Managed pixel transfers use fewer allocations** — Image pixel-copy operations avoid unnecessary managed allocations while preserving their existing behavior. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052))
- **Text processing reuses temporary buffers** — Feature-string handling avoids native temporary allocations, and HarfBuzz text shaping pools its UTF-32 encoding buffer. ([#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
- **Front-buffered streams release retained data** — Front-buffered stream handling no longer retains data after it is no longer needed. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Platform

- **Native WebGPU support is bundled** — The WebGPU implementation is included in libSkiaSharp.a so native consumers receive the required WebGPU support with the library. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
